title: Have a Happy Halloween
text:
Have a Happy Halloween. Want something to welcome guests into your home this Halloween season? If so, then a good option is the DII Happy Halloween Decoration Banner. It spells out the two words Happy Halloween in reasonably eye- catching fashion, letting everyone know that the spirit of Halloween is in high gear.

We often have Halloween parties at our house so when I learned about this banner, I decided it would be a nice addition to the décor. The banner is about 9.5 feet wide so it can stretch across a fairly large space and should work well for most entry ways, tables, walls, etc. It is very light weight and easy to hang and is ready to use out of the package.

As for the design, it’s decent enough. The letters are each on their own, pennant- shaped space, with alternating pegboard background and diagonal stripe background. The letters are orange in color and the combination of background and orange and black gives the banner a decent amount of eye appeal. I say that because I can think of different designs that would have been more apt to jump out at you and thus would have been a little more Halloween- like. But these are good enough to pass.

My main issue with this Happy Halloween banner is the size of the letters. It seemed like they would be a little larger when I ordered the item, but the letters are, in fact, only about 6 inches tall. This isn’t much and they can easily get lost if the banner isn’t placed right. We were going to place this on a table, but the small letters and lack of contrast with the table cloth convinced us that using it as a welcome banner, in our home entry way, is the best way to go.

Halloween is all about decorations, celebrations, trick or treating, and the like. If you have a party in the making this Halloween season and need something to welcome guests, then this banner could be just what you’re looking for. The small size of the letters is cause for some concern, but the banner is still sufficient overall and should be good enough for most needs.
